CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_users` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320),
  `passwordHash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('superadmin','admin','supervisor','tecnico') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tecnico',
  `mustChangePassword` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `lastLoginAt` timestamp NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_users_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fm_users_username_unique` UNIQUE(`username`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_system_settings` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `key` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `value` text,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_system_settings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fm_system_settings_key_unique` UNIQUE(`key`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_projects` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `city` varchar(128),
  `state` varchar(32),
  `centerLat` double,
  `centerLng` double,
  `defaultZoom` int DEFAULT 14,
  `active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_projects_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_pops` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `projectId` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `address` text,
  `lat` double,
  `lng` double,
  `oltModel` varchar(128),
  `oltIp` varchar(64),
  `totalPonPorts` int DEFAULT 0,
  `txPowerDbm` float DEFAULT 3.0,
  `notes` text,
  `pop_status` enum('active','inactive','maintenance') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_pops_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_pon_ports` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `popId` int NOT NULL,
  `board` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `port` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(64),
  `totalOnus` int DEFAULT 128,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_pon_ports_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_cables` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `projectId` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `fiberCount` int NOT NULL,
  `lengthMeters` float,
  `cable_type` enum('aerial','underground','indoor','duct') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aerial',
  `attenuationPerKm` float DEFAULT 0.35,
  `routePoints` json,
  `origin_type` enum('pop','ceo','cto'),
  `originId` int,
  `destination_type` enum('pop','ceo','cto'),
  `destinationId` int,
  `notes` text,
  `cable_status` enum('active','inactive','planned') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_cables_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_ceos` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `projectId` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `lat` double,
  `lng` double,
  `address` text,
  `incomingCableId` int,
  `totalBandejas` int DEFAULT 1,
  `viasPerBandeja` int DEFAULT 12,
  `notes` text,
  `ceo_status` enum('active','inactive','maintenance') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_ceos_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_ceo_bandejas` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `ceoId` int NOT NULL,
  `number` int NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(64),
  `totalVias` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 12,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_ceo_bandejas_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_ceo_tubes` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `ceoId` int NOT NULL,
  `bandejaId` int,
  `tube_type` enum('tube','splitter') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tube',
  `identifier` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `totalVias` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 12,
  `tube_color` enum('verde','amarelo','branco','azul','vermelho','roxo','marrom','rosa','preto','cinza','laranja','aqua'),
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `fm_ceo_tubes_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)

  CONSTRAINT `fm_ceo_vias_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_splitters` (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_ctos` (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `fm_sgp_clients` (
